items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: Me and Jabbo was two good buddies.

ctx.x: And that was it, I think, wasn't it? Well, that's good. So there's the personnel on that. And then, I wanted to ask you about that record session that you made in 1928, where Jabbo disappeared. Jabbo Smith wasn't to be found. And somebody came and got you and got you to play on the James P. Johnson record, in Jabbo's place.

Yeah. They came by and said, 'Now, listen, Cootie, now you've got to take Jabbo's place, because we can't find him.' Me and Jabbo was two good buddies. And then, 'You are Jabbo. When you get down to the recording studio, we're going to call you Jabbo.'
